text:
Seedance 2.0's video extension is wild.

I chained 4 generations to build a full silent scene with "Twig," my wooden puppet character.
No cuts in post. Just prompt → extend → extend → extend.

Tool: @genflow_ai 
Here's how 👇 https://t.co/MAdOnMGw7s
content: Photoreal stop-motion aesthetic throughout. Wide shot of the small wooden puppet creature standing at the base of the giant red mushroom, amber cat-eyes narrowed with determination as he sizes it up. [cut] He steps forward and wraps both wooden arms around the thick fibrous mushroom stem, bracing his feet wide. His whole articulated body strains with effort, joints flexing visibly, but the mushroom barely shifts. [cut] He resets, plants one foot back, and drives his shoulder hard against the stem. The mushroom tips slowly, its weight overcoming him — it wobbles, then topples sideways, gently rolling onto him and pinning him under the cap. [cut] Close-up of his amber cat-eyes peeking out from the shadow under the red mushroom cap, blinking once, undeterred. [cut] Insert shot: the photoreal ladybug on the fern leaf tilts her head, antennae twitching. No music. No dialogue.

thread_texts:
Step 1: Character sheets first, always.

For this scene, I needed Twig + his grandmother (The Elder). 

I used Nano Banana Pro to generate clean multi-angle sheets — front, side, back — so Seedance has a locked visual reference across every generation. https://t.co/kylwwNXMAv

Step 2: I built the source image in Nano Banana Pro using Twig's character sheet + this prompt:

"Generate a photorealistic image of this small wooden puppet character standing at the base of a giant red-capped mushroom in a soft, mossy forest clearing. The scene has the tactile, practical aesthetic of high-end stop-motion puppetry — visible wood grain on the character's body, real moss texture on his head, articulated wooden joints. The mushroom is at least three times his height, with a thick fibrous white stem and a glossy red cap dotted with white spots, photographed with realistic subsurface scattering on the cap. The character is looking up at it with wide amber cat-eyes full of determination, sleeves of his burlap rucksack visible, arms slightly raised as if preparing to lift. Soft morning light filters through real-looking forest foliage. A small ladybug — also photoreal, with detail on her shell — sits on a nearby fern leaf, watching. Shallow depth of field, 50mm lens look, naturalistic color grade. No animation or cartoon styling."

Step 3: Uploaded the source image + Twig's character sheet into Seedance 2.0. Prompt:

"Photoreal stop-motion aesthetic throughout. Wide shot of the small wooden puppet creature standing at the base of the giant red mushroom, amber cat-eyes narrowed with determination as he sizes it up. [cut] He steps forward and wraps both wooden arms around the thick fibrous mushroom stem, bracing his feet wide. His whole articulated body strains with effort, joints flexing visibly, but the mushroom barely shifts. [cut] He resets, plants one foot back, and drives his shoulder hard against the stem. The mushroom tips slowly, its weight overcoming him — it wobbles, then topples sideways, gently rolling onto him and pinning him under the cap. [cut] Close-up of his amber cat-eyes peeking out from the shadow under the red mushroom cap, blinking once, undeterred. [cut] Insert shot: the photoreal ladybug on the fern leaf tilts her head, antennae twitching. No music. No dialogue."

Step 4: Upload the Gen 1 video back into Seedance as reference + character sheets. Prompt:

"Extend the video. Maintain the photoreal stop-motion puppet aesthetic. The small wooden creature wriggles out from under the mushroom cap, stands up, and brushes moss and dirt from his arms with quick wooden movements. [cut] He plants both palms against the side of the fallen mushroom and starts pushing. The mushroom rolls slowly across the moss, then faster as the forest floor slopes gently downward. [cut] Side tracking shot of the mushroom accelerating, rolling away from him. His amber cat-eyes go wide as he realizes he's lost control. [cut] He sprints after the runaway mushroom, wooden legs pumping with articulated joint motion, arms outstretched. [cut] The ladybug on the fern leaf watches the mushroom roll past, antennae snapping up in alarm. No music. No dialogue."

Step 5: Same process. Upload Gen 2 + character sheets. Prompt:

"Extend the video. Maintain the photoreal stop-motion puppet aesthetic with naturalistic lighting. Tracking shot of the runaway mushroom rolling through the forest, crashing through a small pile of real-looking dry leaves, which scatter into the air. [cut] The small wooden creature chases behind it, leaping over a fallen mossy branch, arms outstretched. [cut] Wide shot revealing a small gnarled wooden cottage ahead in a sunlit clearing. The grandmother creature — an older, weathered, grey-driftwood puppet with mossy lichen hair, woven shawl, and a twisted crystal staff — stands in the open doorway, calm and watching. The mushroom rolls directly toward her. [cut] Close-up of the small creature's horrified face as he runs, mouth slightly open, amber cat-eyes huge. [cut] The ladybug, clinging to a leaf, kicked into the air, spins helplessly in slow motion. No music. No dialogue."

Step 6: Final extension. Upload Gen 3 + character sheets. Prompt:

"Extend the video. Maintain the photoreal stop-motion puppet aesthetic. The runaway mushroom rolls to a perfect, gentle stop right at the grandmother's gnarled wooden feet. Dust and leaves settle slowly around her. [cut] The small wooden creature stumbles to a halt a few steps behind it, panting, hands braced on his wooden knees, exhausted and bracing for her reaction. [cut] The grandmother looks down at the giant mushroom with a calm, knowing expression. She bends slightly and lifts the mushroom effortlessly with one weathered hand, as if it weighs nothing at all. Her crystal staff stays planted in her other hand. [cut] Close-up of the small creature's face — amber cat-eyes wide, mouth slightly open in stunned disbelief. The grandmother reaches over and gently pats his mossy head, then turns and walks toward the cottage carrying the mushroom under one arm. [cut] Final shot: the ladybug, having landed on a small pebble nearby, watches the grandmother walk away with the mushroom. Her tiny legs give out and she falls flat on her back, legs in the air, in pure shock. No music. No dialogue."

Step 7: Stitched all four generations together in a video editor. No additional cuts. No music. Just the chain.

That's the whole scene — one continuous silent story built across 4 Seedance extensions.
"Twig" is an ongoing series. More coming. https://t.co/lWOk7BqG6f

A few things I learned about chaining extensions:
→ Always upload the original character sheets, not just the previous video. Motion continuity comes from the clip; character consistency comes from the sheets.
→ Small reactive characters (like the ladybug) will drift between generations. Make sure they're crisp in your opening + closing shots — the middle can be messy.
→ End every prompt with "No music. No dialogue (If there's no dialogue)." 
Seedance will otherwise sometimes add stock sound.
Follow for the next one 🌱

Estética de stop-motion fotorrealista ao longo de toda a cena. [corte] Close-up dos olhos de gato âmbar espiando da sombra sob o chapéu vermelho do cogumelo, piscando uma vez, imperturbável. [Thread 1] Passo 1: Fichas de personagens primeiro, sempre.

Para esta cena, eu precisava de Twig + sua avó (A Anciã).

Usei o Nano Banana Pro para gerar fichas limpas de múltiplos ângulos — frente, lado, costas — para que o Seedance tenha uma referência visual fixa em cada geração. https://t.co/kylwwNXMAv

[Thread 2] Passo 2: Construí a imagem fonte no Nano Banana Pro usando a ficha de personagem do Twig + este prompt:

"Generate a photorealistic image of this small wooden puppet character standing at the base of a giant red-capped mushroom in a soft, mossy forest clearing. The scene has the tactile, practical aesthetic of high-end stop-motion puppetry — visible wood grain on the character's body, real moss texture on his head, articulated wooden joints. The mushroom is at least three times his height, with a thick fibrous white stem and a glossy red cap dotted with white spots, photographed with realistic subsurface scattering on the cap. The character is looking up at it with wide amber cat-eyes full of determination, sleeves of his burlap rucksack visible, arms slightly raised as if preparing to lift. Soft morning light filters through real-looking forest foliage. A small ladybug — also photoreal, with detail on her shell — sits on a nearby fern leaf, watching. Shallow depth of field, 50mm lens look, naturalistic color grade. No animation or cartoon styling."

[Thread 3] Passo 3: Carreguei a imagem fonte + a ficha de personagem do Twig no Seedance 2.0. Prompt:

"Photoreal stop-motion aesthetic throughout. Wide shot of the small wooden puppet creature standing at the base of the giant red mushroom, amber cat-eyes narrowed with determination as he sizes it up. [cut] He steps forward and wraps both wooden arms around the thick fibrous mushroom stem, bracing his feet wide. His whole articulated body strains with effort, joints flexing visibly, but the mushroom barely shifts. [cut] He resets, plants one foot back, and drives his shoulder hard against the stem. The mushroom tips slowly, its weight overcoming him — it wobbles, then topples sideways, gently rolling onto him and pinning him under the cap. [cut] Close-up of his amber cat-eyes peeking out from the shadow under the red mushroom cap, blinking once, undeterred. [cut] Insert shot: the photoreal ladybug on the fern leaf tilts her head, antennae twitching. No music. No dialogue."

[Thread 4] Passo 4: Carregue o vídeo Gen 1 de volta no Seedance como referência + fichas de personagens. Prompt:

"Extend the video. Maintain the photoreal stop-motion puppet aesthetic. The small wooden creature wriggles out from under the mushroom cap, stands up, and brushes moss and dirt from his arms with quick wooden movements. [cut] He plants both palms against the side of the fallen mushroom and starts pushing. The mushroom rolls slowly across the moss, then faster as the forest floor slopes gently downward. [cut] Side tracking shot of the mushroom accelerating, rolling away from him. His amber cat-eyes go wide as he realizes he's lost control. [cut] He sprints after the runaway mushroom, wooden legs pumping with articulated joint motion, arms outstretched. [cut] The ladybug on the fern leaf watches the mushroom roll past, antennae snapping up in alarm. No music. No dialogue."

[Thread 5] Passo 5: Mesmo processo. Carregue Gen 2 + fichas de personagens. Prompt:

"Extend the video. Maintain the photoreal stop-motion puppet aesthetic with naturalistic lighting. Tracking shot of the runaway mushroom rolling through the forest, crashing through a small pile of real-looking dry leaves, which scatter into the air. [cut] The small wooden creature chases behind it, leaping over a fallen mossy branch, arms outstretched. [cut] Wide shot revealing a small gnarled wooden cottage ahead in a sunlit clearing. The grandmother creature — an older, weathered, grey-driftwood puppet with mossy lichen hair, woven shawl, and a twisted crystal staff — stands in the open doorway, calm and watching. The mushroom rolls directly toward her. [cut] Close-up of the small creature's horrified face as he runs, mouth slightly open, amber cat-eyes huge. [cut] The ladybug, clinging to a leaf, kicked into the air, spins helplessly in slow motion. No music. No dialogue."

[Thread 6] Passo 6: Extensão final. Carregue Gen 3 + fichas de personagens. Prompt:

"Extend the video. Maintain the photoreal stop-motion puppet aesthetic. The runaway mushroom rolls to a perfect, gentle stop right at the grandmother's gnarled wooden feet. Dust and leaves settle slowly around her. [cut] The small wooden creature stumbles to a halt a few steps behind it, panting, hands braced on his wooden knees, exhausted and bracing for her reaction. [cut] The grandmother looks down at the giant mushroom with a calm, knowing expression. She bends slightly and lifts the mushroom effortlessly with one weathered hand, as if it weighs nothing at all. Her crystal staff stays planted in her other hand. [cut] Close-up of the small creature's face — amber cat-eyes wide, mouth slightly open in stunned disbelief. The grandmother reaches over and gently pats his mossy head, then turns and walks toward the cottage carrying the mushroom under one arm. [cut] Final shot: the ladybug, having landed on a small pebble nearby, watches the grandmother walk away with the mushroom. Her tiny legs give out and she falls flat on her back, legs in the air, in pure shock. No music. No dialogue."

[Thread 7] Passo 7: Juntei todas as quatro gerações em um editor de vídeo. Sem cortes adicionais. Sem música. Apenas a sequência.

Essa é a cena inteira — uma história silenciosa contínua construída ao longo de 4 extensões do Seedance. "Twig" é uma série em andamento. Mais por vir. https://t.co/lWOk7BqG6f

[Thread 8] Algumas coisas que aprendi sobre encadear extensões:
→ Sempre carregue as fichas de personagens originais, não apenas o vídeo anterior. A continuidade do movimento vem do clipe; a consistência do personagem vem das fichas.
→ Pequenos personagens reativos (como a joaninha) podem se deslocar entre gerações. Certifique-se de que eles estejam nítidos em suas cenas de abertura + fechamento — o meio pode ser bagunçado.
→ Termine cada prompt com "No music. No dialogue (If there's no dialogue)." 
Caso contrário, o Seedance às vezes adiciona som de estoque.
Siga para o próximo 🌱
